value: Minigirl game with a vore and transformation focus

Julia runs a magic shop with her friends, selling rare spells and potions. The business is going horribly, and they are short on rent. As a last resort, Julia decides to seek out new customers to display her shrinking and transformation spells to.
Shrink to different sizes and transform into nearby objects to trigger scenes. Stamina struggle system to escape capture
